title: Deps reports one missing dependency as one error
description: deps reports one missing dependency as one error
no_spec_change_rationale: The deps acceptance criterion already says validate_deps reports an error for each declared dependency whose target has no spec; one missing dependency produced two errors. This makes the count match the existing requirement
acceptance_criteria: a spec whose depends_on names a module with no spec yields exactly one deps error for it, the 'Dependency spec not found' verdict check gives, for bare and path entries; missing_deps still names the edge; the regression_w1 pin now expects one occurrence

answers.constraints: the edge stays in the graph so missing_deps and the JSON keep naming the target; the public DepNode shape is unchanged
